critical_code_review_comments: Backend hardening looks production-ready: every /api/admin/*, /api/pm/*, /api/field-leadership/list endpoint correctly returns 401/403 without proper token. Cross-role rejection works (X-Leadership-Token alone cannot read /api/admin/project-managers).
No Mongo `_id` leakage on any of the 5 sampled public endpoints (jobs, jhas, trench-boxes, employees, suppliers).

Photo performance API is solid: /thumb honors Accept negotiation (200 + image/* content-type), /raw returns data_url, /raw-batch caps at 50 ids and silently drops out-of-scope items. /raw-batch payload field is `photo_ids` (NOT `ids`) — frontend callers must match.
Service Worker (/sw-thumbs.js) loads + registers + activates correctly on the preview origin; verified in real browser context.

Hub home order matches iter46 spec exactly: [Field, QA/QC, Safety, Field Leadership, PM Portal, Shop, Training Hub, Projects, Admin]. Field Leadership tile uses slate accent and sits immediately after Safety; Projects sits before Admin in the operational tile group.

ES (Spanish) translation coverage on Hub home is excellent — all marketing copy, tile descriptions, section labels, button labels (ENTRAR A LA SECCIÓN, INFORMACIÓN DE LA EMPRESA) translate. Only the literal string 'Field Leadership' as a tile H2 was missed.
Mobile responsive: 375x812 viewport produces ZERO horizontal scroll on Hub home. Tap targets and content are vertically stacked cleanly.

All 50 prior regression tests (iter42 field_leadership, iter44 equipment_checkout, iter45 equipment_return) still pass. PDFs still embed ForgedOps footer and gate at >=3KB with %PDF magic bytes (verified via test_pdf_bytes_and_footer).
